Carrying a regular list price at $350, this is an impressive $100 price drop, the best deal we have ever tracked, and a new all-time low. This deal even undercuts the best open-box discounts we have tracked up until today.

The new Beats 360 feature a modular a headband cushion and earpads setup so you can flip them out to mix match the style or just to refresh them after a work out. You’ll also land “up to 1.75x more noise cancellation than Beats Studio Pro” on the brand’s “first-ever sweat and water resistant over-ear headphone.”
